response.sql: WITH cat AS (SELECT category, AVG(remaining) AS avg_remaining, SUM(CASE WHEN amount IS NOT NULL AND spent IS NOT NULL THEN amount - spent END) AS total FROM budget WHERE amount > 75 GROUP BY category), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total) AS avg_total FROM cat) SELECT cat.category, cat.avg_remaining, cat.total, cat.total - overall.avg_total AS above_avg FROM cat, overall WHERE overall.avg_total IS NOT NULL AND cat.total > overall.avg_total;
